warn.agyNameScope: Antigravity treats a name across user and workspace settings: enabled: false on either stops both, and if both are enabled both run.
warn.askToDeny: Codex does not support ask. If the original command answers ask or defer, the tool is denied.
warn.allowToAgy: In Antigravity, allow does not replace the permission check (Antigravity still asks).
warn.updatedInputDeny: Antigravity cannot rewrite tool input, so an updatedInput answer denies the tool.
warn.agyAskToClaude: ask and force_ask become Claude Code ask; deny_unless_prior_grant becomes deny. allow means no opinion (Claude Code still checks permissions).
warn.agyAskToCodex: Codex does not support ask, so ask, force_ask and deny_unless_prior_grant deny the tool. allow means no opinion.
warn.failAgy: If the original command fails (exit 1, exit 2, bad JSON, timeout), the tool is stopped, as Antigravity does.
warn.failGate: A timeout, start failure, missing command or output above 1 MiB stops the tool. Ordinary exit 2 still stops it; other failures retain their original meaning.
warn.postToAgy: Antigravity does not read PostToolUse answers (decision: block, continue: false and extra context have no effect).
warn.postSkipFailure: Claude Code PostToolUse only runs after a tool succeeds. The original command is not run for failed tools.
warn.postFromAgy: PostToolUse answers are not passed on (Antigravity does not read them, so this keeps the original meaning).
warn.postFailureCodex: Codex PostToolUse also runs after failed tools (Claude Code only after successes).
warn.postBlock: PostToolUse decision: block means different things (Claude Code tells the model the reason; Codex replaces the tool result with it).
warn.stopMeaning: Stop means different things (the end of the run loop in Antigravity, the end of a turn in Claude Code and Codex). "Keep going" (block ↔ continue) is converted; on failure the agent is let stop.
warn.stopInput: Consecutive continuations are counted per conversation and stop after five. From Claude Code or Codex to Antigravity, the last assistant message is unavailable and sent empty.
warn.permissionRequest: PermissionRequest answer details (rule updates and so on) differ between agents.
warn.inputShape: Tool input is converted to the closest shape (shell, file and search tools). Other tools get their input as it is.
warn.scriptMissing: The file the command points to ({{path}}) was not found. The script is not copied, so it will not run in the target either.
warn.scriptRelative: The command uses a relative path ({{path}}). The folder it is relative to changes in the target.
